storageContracts.currentBehavior: Every read/resolve verifies the active lease; plugin bundle hash and native revision/content hash are pinned; stale calls onStale then throws; missing roots/resources throw; credential absence, revision mismatch or expiry throws revoked. A successful bundle verification is memoized for the lifetime of ONE materializer instance (= one snapshot lease = one turn), so verifyPlugin hashes a bundle once however many MCP servers and source resources reach it; assertActive still runs on every call, and stale/missing outcomes are never memoized. computeBundleHash is a test-only injection seam defaulting to computeNormalizedBundleHash.
resolve acquires sorted immutable plugin-instance leases; release removes the record and releases in reverse; withCapabilityRuntime releases in finally on success, error, abort or disconnect.
toAgentRuntime projects one EffectiveCapabilitySnapshot generation without rediscovery; only runnable entries enter the server-only path/resource/credential view.
refresh leaves the captured processing generation intact; revoke marks matching live leases revoked immediately; project-trust fans out by projectKey and plugin scope conservatively fails closed.
Renderer DTOs are path/secret-free; projectKey is opaque, icons are data/app URLs and server runtime resources never cross the safe boundary.

Folder selection grants nothing; stable trust requires matching projectKey plus identityFingerprint; process-only decisions are memory-only; untrusted project inventory withholds repository-owned layers and emits one path-free blocked layer.
Runtime composition requires verified-v2 readiness; sessions are composite-keyed and stored beneath managed workspace/session roots.
